inlines.v: SLED'DING, participle present tense Conveying on a sled. SLED'DING, noun The act of transporting on a sled. 2. The means of conveying on sleds; snow sufficient for the running of sleds. Thus we say in America, when there is snow sufficient to run a sled, it is good sledding during the winter.
